Fliplet | Hiring: Technical Team Lead (UK/EU) & Outbound SDR (Canada) | Remote

https://careers.fliplet.com/#jobs

Fliplet is an AI-led software creation platform helping organizations build secure mobile and web applications faster. We help enterprise teams move from idea to production-ready software using AI prompts while maintaining the governance, security, and control required for business use.

We are growing and currently hiring for two roles:

1) Technical Team Lead | Engineering | Remote

We’re looking for a hands-on Technical Team Lead who enjoys coding, solving complex problems, and helping engineers grow. This is a coding-first leadership role where you’ll spend significant time contributing to the codebase while also owning technical direction, engineering standards, and team development.

2) Outbound Sales Development Representative | Sales | Remote (Canada)

We’re looking for a proactive SDR who enjoys outbound prospecting and building relationships with potential customers.

Apply here: https://careers.fliplet.com/#jobs
